game.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
game.blurb: Turn-based 4X strategy game from Firaxis (RAWG also lists Aspyr Media), published by 2K Games, released 2016-10-20. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: Strategy, Simulation. A 4X game has no story chapters, so these chapters are built from Steam achievement themes: difficulty, victory types and maps, leaders, civilization feats, scenarios and game modes.

chapters.title: Difficulty Ladder
chapters.summary: Winning a regular game at each difficulty from Settler up to Deity.

chapters.title: Victory Types, Maps and Era Starts
chapters.summary: Science, Religious, Culture, Domination and Diplomatic victories, winning on each map type and size, and winning from later era starts.

chapters.title: Leaders
chapters.summary: Winning a regular game with each leader.

chapters.title: Civilization Feats
chapters.summary: One-off goals for playing as a particular civilization or leader.

chapters.title: Scenarios
chapters.summary: The scenarios named in the achievements: Vikings, Traders, and Raiders!, Jadwiga's Legacy, Outback Tycoon, Conquests of Alexander, Gifts of the Nile, Path to Nirvana, the Black Death, War Machine, the Red Death and Pirates, with their factions.

chapters.title: Game Modes
chapters.summary: Apocalypse mode, Secret Societies, Dramatic Ages, Heroes, monopolies and corporations, Barbarian Clans, zombies and traps.

chapters.title: Empire, Diplomacy and Wonders
chapters.summary: Everyday goals: districts, wonders, governors, emergencies, alliances, spies, ages, great people, natural wonders and multiplayer.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 289070 ("Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI"); its schema is named "Madrizzle" (an internal codename). None of the 320 Steam achievements is hidden, and most are below 5%. The achievements name ten scenarios but no expansion titles, so expansions are not named anywhere in this entry. Red Death and Pirates faction achievements (written as "Faction - goal") are grouped with the scenarios because they sit among those scenario achievements. StrategyWiki has "Sid Meier's Civilization VI" as a stub (completion stage 0); written subpages are Table of Contents, Achievements and trophies, Game Modes, Heroes & Legends, Historic Moments, "Jadawiga's Legacy" (spelled that way), and the civilization pages Alexander, America and Arabia. It has no walkthrough, so it was not used. civilization.fandom.com redirects "Sid Meier's Civilization VI" to "Civilization VI", with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG lists iOS, Nintendo Switch, PS4 and Xbox One as well as PC, macOS and Linux.
